enabled.name: Record inputs
enabled.description: Record gameplay input events. Applied on the next attempt.

show-hud.name: Show recorder HUD
show-hud.description: Display input count and last observed progress counter. Applied on next level entry.

verbose-log.name: Log every input
verbose-log.description: Print every captured event in the Geode log. Applied on the next attempt.

replay-on-restart.name: Replay on pause restart (test)
replay-on-restart.description: Opt-in: replay the current valid recording when you restart from the pause menu in a local level. Disable to record only.

checkpoint-probe.name: Checkpoint restore probe (test)
checkpoint-probe.description: Local classic Practice Mode only. Disable auto checkpoints, manually place one, do not press gameplay inputs until the 120-sample baseline is ready, then die and compare the native respawn. Applied on next level entry.

window-scan.name: Single-jump window scan (test)
window-scan.description: Local normal mode only. Record one jump, release, survive 0.5s, then pause and restart. Tests 17 offsets automatically. Takes precedence over replay-on-restart. Pause to stop.

fast-window-scan.name: Checkpoint acceleration (test)
fast-window-scan.description: Requires Single-jump window scan. Local classic levels only. Enters Practice Mode during scan; validates restored baseline before shifted trials. Disable to compare full restart results.
